provenance.review_target: A reported 39479-line, 1.62 MB MKTCTX/3 packet with 161 indexed files; exact artifact not identified

claims: The reviewer reported reading all 39479 lines, reverse-engineering the grammar in one pass, and running measurements.
The reviewer reported verifying the path-derived file ID algorithm with .continuum/release.yml and inferring the manifest-derived packet ID algorithm.
The reviewer measured a 362 KB symbols section, 2681 symbol entries, 489 range=unknown entries, 632 content chunks, and 472 chunks of exactly 64 lines.
The reviewer reported that all 161 index records repeated projection=exact and reason=selected.

positive_findings: The packet was understandable without an external specification, and the compact guide taught the citation and trust grammar efficiently.
Index-first ordering exposed the repository map before source content.
Path-derived file IDs, symbol IDs, and inclusive line ranges provided a useful grounded citation system.
Explicit coverage, omissions, and integrity fields made provenance and epistemic limits visible.
Exact content plus per-file digests made file-level reconstruction verifiable, subject to the repository's unresolved encoding-exactness gap.
reviewer_characterization: A self-describing, integrity-checked repository projection format for handing selected code to models with stable citations and explicit trust framing.
A context-layer evidence object rather than merely a repository concatenation format.
Potential infrastructure for context lockfiles, PR review bundles, reproducible bug reports, verifiable retrieval, and compliance snapshots.
reviewer_priority: Reduce symbol and attribute overhead, populate dependency edges for ranked selection, then add deltas, mixed-fidelity projections, verification tooling, and a concise specification.

available_evidence: The complete review and its reported measurements were relayed by the user.
The repository contains the MKTCTX/3 renderer, parser, tests, adversarial fixture, example packets, and previously captured overlapping review proposals.
limitations: The reviewed packet and measurement commands were not supplied, so its size and count claims cannot be independently reproduced from this intake alone.
The exact and alias counts are inferred from the reviewer's statement that all 161 index records carry projection=exact.
The terminator fixed-point characterization is not the complete collision argument because the generator already scans payload lines and deterministically expands a colliding term.
The claim of byte-exact losslessness remains subject to the known UTF-8 BOM decoding and hashing mismatch recorded in earlier intake.
